criticalFindings.finding: Non-CAST 16/32 manuals, CAST 16/32 manuals and repeaters remain separate. Official 16-zone engineering Rev 3 matches the Rev 1 access tree; newer network caveat retained.
Original Twinflex V3, pro V1/V2 and pro² V3 are distinct. Stale pro archive titles for current Rev 18 installer / Rev 5 user / Rev 3 repeater no longer establish a pro association.

Fike current covers visibly show Rev 18 and Rev 5; old Issue 14 Draft / Issue 3 strings exist in extracted template text. These are recorded as extraction artifacts, not assumed visual version badges.
505-0007 excludes earlier pro and 2-zone pro². 505-0006 pro sheet is additionally corroborated for pro² by Rev 18 engineering PDF page 20; only 4-zone expansion is supported.
Four alias groups have identical PDF bytes. Further aliases share document identity/edition and normalized full text; distinct PDF hashes stay separate for page-opening verification.
